data_fields.name: chance_pct
data_fields.donor_constant: default 100; 50 on the URBAN road lines

best_idea: A zone layout is an ordered list of data commands (place a hub, draw a road, fill the rest) with labels, conditionals, chances and use caps, so a designer can change a town's shape without touching code.
decision_why: Take the command grammar as zone data; fix the donor's overlap check (BattlescapeGenerator.cpp:2724), the fill stop (2183-2190) and the road column bias (2677); reject the tile, MCD and node loaders, which Frankendom does not use.
acceptance: A server test with a fixed seed builds a 5x5 zone with exactly four 2x2 hubs and no overlapping footprints across 1000 seeds; road outcomes come out near 50/25/25 percent (vertical, horizontal, cross); the same seed gives the same layout on the server and the client renders it without re-rolling.
